title: Current magnitude
description: Essential: Correct calculation of current through ab using Ohm's law with all resistances in series.

title: Current direction
description: Essential: Correct identification that current flows from a to b (or equivalent direction specification).

title: Ampere force magnitude
description: Essential: Correct calculation of Ampere force using F = BIL with given values.

title: Force equilibrium setup
description: Important: Correct application of static equilibrium conditions for both horizontal and vertical forces on ab.

title: Friction direction cases
description: Important: Consideration of both cases where friction acts left or right to determine G range.

title: Normal force calculation
description: Important: Correct determination of normal force from vertical equilibrium including magnetic force component.

title: Tension-G relationship
description: Important: Recognition that rope tension equals gravitational force G on hanging mass.

title: Sign error in friction
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign for friction force in equilibrium equations (direction confusion).

title: Magnetic force components
description: Pitfall: Failure to resolve magnetic force into horizontal (sinα) and vertical (cosα) components.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Consistent use of SI units throughout calculations without conversion errors.
